listing.name: Immersion Friendly Portrait Pack
listing.aiSummary: Adds 28 new character portraits with three color themes: vanilla, red, and white.

description:
Immersion Friendly Portraits

Spot the difference!

Features

28 Portraits
Quality
Diversity
Artistic consistency
Lore consistency
3 "Themes" for you to choose, vanilla, red and white

Preview

Vanilla: Spoiler

Red: Spoiler

White: Spoiler

Download Links

Vanilla: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VT0zXKqguXMG1tM3xHN3cTqh66WMRArz/view?usp=sharing
Red: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gFz5Kaf4BclKwxbZqt5a-6HfRTZPJ4rr/view?usp=sharing
White: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1g7-QnmrzjMviXayA156hnl6zhzZWqY-i/view?usp=sharing

Installation

Download and unpack in your game "mods" directory.

Addendum

There are at the moment 28 portraits added. I plan to add more eventually.

I can also make a more different "versions" if there's a demand for it as long as it's just recolors.

Also, let me know if the lighting colors/placement feels too similar since I can easily change it, if you feel that some portraits are out of place I can also remove them.

All images are property of their respective owners.

I will also try and find the original artists so I can give proper credits.
